Messages.Author: Mike Nudd
Messages.Body:
Last night we were playing, and one guy had some Lasombra in his deck
including Angelica, the Canonicus. Angelica can only use her special ability
to gain intercept once during the current action, correct? How much
intercept is she allowed to gain in this manner? Is she a) only permitted to
gain intercept to equal the current stealth level of the acting minion, or
b) can she gain any amount of intercept she wishes?

Regards,

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
"Mike Nudd" <mi...@vekn.org.uk> wrote:
> Last night we were playing, and one guy had some Lasombra in his deck
> including Angelica, the Canonicus. Angelica can only use her special
> ability to gain intercept once during the current action, correct? How
> much intercept is she allowed to gain in this manner? Is she a) only
> permitted to gain intercept to equal the current stealth level of the
> acting minion, or b) can she gain any amount of intercept she wishes?

She gains X intercept, where X is the number of master cards you
burn from your hand. X can be any number you choose, up to your
current hand size. It may be more than the amount of intercept
currently needed.
